# The Italian Chef

> > Authentic Italian recipes and culinary traditions from Chef Silvia Bianco, featuring regional specialties from Bologna, Rome, Naples, and Emilia-Romagna.

The Italian Chef offers traditional Italian cooking guidance with a focus on classic dishes like Lasagna Bolognese, pasta recipes, and regional sauces. Led by Chef Silvia from Ridgefield, CT, the site celebrates authentic Italian cuisine from various regions including Lazio and Southern Italian styles.

## Key Topics

- Lasagna Bolognese
- Béchamel Sauce
- Parmigiano-Reggiano
- Spaghetti alla Gricia
- guanciale
- pancetta
- ricotta cheese
- homemade pasta
- traditional Italian cooking
- Southern Italian Style
- Emilia-Romagna cuisine
- Rome and Lazio region
- Chef Silvia Bianco
- vegetarian lasagna
- Italian meat dishes

## Pasta & Lasagna Recipes

- [Lasagna Recipes - The Italian Chef](https://italianchef.com/lasagna-recipes): Lasagna recipes featuring Bolognese, Béchamel, and Parmigiano-Reggiano

## Sauces & Broths

- [Sauce & Broth Recipes - The Italian Chef](https://italianchef.com/sauce-broth-recipes): Italian sauce & broth recipes from Bologna, Naples, and Emilia-Romagna

## Meat Recipes

- [Pork & Lamb Recipes - The Italian Chef](https://italianchef.com/pork-lamb-recipes): Traditional Italian pork & lamb recipes including Spaghetti alla Gricia
